verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a self-contained sandbox that simulates the live production environment, and its other docs refer to separate sandbox environments and recommend using the sandbox for initial testing. However, nothing in the evidence shows test cards or ways to simulate declines and disputes, which are a large part of the story. Missing for 10: documented test card numbers, decline/error scenario simulation, sandbox dispute/chargeback simulation, independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity.
